transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer support, my name is Simon. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Simon. I am at my wits' end with our landline phone. We are getting inundated with over twenty automated spam and scam calls every single day, ringing from seven in the morning until ten at night!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check your landline calling features, but first I must complete security. Can you confirm your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Felix Montgomery, 15 St John's Terrace, York, YO31 8ER.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account, Felix?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What types of nuisance calls are you receiving on the line?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Recorded voices claiming to be from the tax office, international accident claims, and silent robocalls hanging up. My cordless handset model is the BT 4600 Trio.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are the incoming numbers displaying on your handset screen or showing as 'Withheld'?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Most of them spoof local York numbers, but when I pick up it's a computer robot voice.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net does not control public telephone number spoofing across third-party carrier networks, so spam calls are essentially the regulator's problem, not ours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do you mean it's not your problem? S-Net provides my telephone line! My eighty-two-year-old father gets confused and terrified by these aggressive scam calls!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you keep giving out your home phone number on online prize draws and website forms, obviously you're going to get spammed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My father doesn't even own a computer, Simon! That comment is completely insulting!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I said, automated dialers harvest numbers sequentially across the entire national dial plan.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there any call blocking feature available on S-Net that can stop these callers?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we have S-Net Call Guardian, which intercepts all callers who are not in your pre-approved VIP contact directory.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does Call Guardian work in practice?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When an unknown number calls, the system asks them to record their name. Telemarketers and automated robocallers automatically disconnect because they cannot speak a name.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds exactly like what we need. How do we turn it on?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can provision Call Guardian on your exchange profile. Bear with me for a moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Felix. Call Guardian feature code has been applied to your landline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to do anything with our handsets?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check your phone setup again. Which phone handset model do you have connected to the landline?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you earlier, we have the BT 4600 Trio cordless handsets.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, the BT 4600 has built-in Call Guardian support, so we should sync it with our network feature.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Would you also like me to activate International Inbound Barring, so overseas call centers cannot ring the line at all?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please! We have no relatives living abroad, so we have zero need for international calls.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have toggled international call barring to active on your exchange switch. Any incoming foreign number will receive a number unavailable tone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That cuts out another massive chunk of these scam operations.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And we also register your number with the Telephone Preference Service automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We registered with the TPS years ago, but rogue callers simply ignore the registry.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Call Guardian operates at the hardware exchange level, so it enforces blocking regardless of TPS compliance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's why hardware screening is so much more effective.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can blacklist specific nuisance callers by dialing 14258 right after an unwanted call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 14258, noted. That's very easy to remember.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do I add our doctor, pharmacy, and family members so they get straight through?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You program them into your handset phonebook as VIP contacts. Anyone saved in the address book bypasses the screening announcement completely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me add my mobile number right now into the cordless base unit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Added my mobile to the phonebook as 'Felix Mobile'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's test the call screening. I will place a test call from an unlisted office extension to your landline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am standing by the phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Dialing your landline 01904 682914 now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone didn't ring! It just flashed on the screen saying 'Call Screened - Robocall Blocked'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Because I did not announce a recognized name, the exchange rejected the call without waking your household.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is absolute magic! That will stop these scammers in their tracks!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now call your landline from your mobile to test VIP pass-through.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing landline from my mobile now... It's ringing through with the custom ringtone! Answered it and crystal clear line!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms VIP contacts ring through instantly while all unverified callers are blocked.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is going to bring so much peace and quiet back to our home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing contact email on file, it's felix dot montgomery at yorkshire dot net, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my correct email address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm for the switch records, the installation address is 15 St John's Terrace, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 15 St John's Terrace.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your telephone service that I can help you with today, Felix?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Simon, despite the rocky start, Call Guardian works brilliantly. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Felix, and have a quiet afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Simon, goodbye.
